text: In Lagos, a phone importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.
heard: In Lagos, a phone importer sends a 30% deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.

text: The other seventy percent is still to come. That balance is where it goes wrong.
heard: The other 70% is still to come. That balance is where it goes wrong. [BUZZER]

text: Goods that never arrive. Payments redirected by a fake "our bank details have changed" message.
heard: Goods that never arrive, payments redirected by a fake message, our bank details have changed.

text: A naira that can lose a third of its value between the deposit and the balance.
heard: a naira that can lose a third of its value between the deposit and the balance.

text: And letters of credit have almost vanished, so most of this trade moves by plain bank transfer.
heard: and letters of credit have almost vanished, so most of this trade moves by plane bank transfer.

text: Arra fixes that. Arra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.
heard: Aura fixes that. Aura is Latin for earnest money, the deposit that secures a deal.

text: Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked until it ships, in an open contract on Celo: not with Arra, not with the supplier.
heard: Pay the deposit and keep the balance locked until it ships in an open contract on cello. Not with Aura, not with the supplier.

text: Start by describing the order, like a message. Arra's assistant turns it into clear terms.
heard: Start by describing the order, like a message. ARA's assistant turns it into clear terms.

text: Words nobody can check, like "good quality", are refused, and the terms are fingerprinted so they can't change later.
heard: Words nobody can check, like good quality, are refused. And the terms are fingerprinted, so they can't change later. [BUZZER]

text: Then send your supplier one link. They read the exact terms, in English or Chinese, connect the wallet they want to be paid in, and agree.
heard: Then, send your supplier one link. They read the exact terms, in English or Chinese, connect the wallet they want to be paid in and agree.

text: No account numbers copied from a chat, so a scammer's look-alike address can't slip in.
heard: No account numbers copied from a chat, so a scammer's lookalike address can't slip in.

text: Pay in dollars, or straight from naira, even inside MiniPay.
heard: Pay in dollars or straight from Naira, even inside mini pay.

text: The supplier accepts and gets the deposit instantly. The balance waits until the goods ship.
heard: The supplier accepts and gets the deposit instantly. The balance waits until the goods ship.

text: Every naira payment is a Textile FX fill: a firm quote for exactly the dollars the order needs, settled in one transaction.
heard: Every NIRA payment is a textile FX fill. A firm quote for exactly the dollars the order needs settled in one transaction.

text: Our first one on mainnet turned naira, at about thirteen hundred and seventy-four to the dollar, straight into a locked order.
heard: Our first one on Main Net turned Naira. At about $1,374 to the dollar, straight into a locked order.

text: That one rate matters. In 2023, an importer with a seven-thousand-dollar balance needed two million naira more, just seven weeks later.
heard: That one rate matters. In 2023, an importer with a $7,000 balance needed 2 million Naira more just seven weeks later.

text: With Arra, that balance was paid for on day one.
heard: With Aura, that balance was paid for on day one.

text: When the goods arrive, check them. Everything's right? Pay the balance with one tap, all at once or in parts.
heard: When the goods arrive, check them. Everything's right. Pay the balance with one tap, all at once or in parts. [BUZZER]

text: Something wrong? Report it with a photo. The supplier accepts, or makes an offer.
heard: Something wrong, report it with a photo. The supplier accepts or makes an offer.

text: Changed your mind before they accept? Cancel and get everything back. If they never accept, or never ship, Arra's agent refunds you automatically.
heard: changed your mind before they accept, cancel, and get everything back. If they never accept or never ship, R is Agent refuns you automatically.

text: Silence can't freeze the money, and nobody, not even Arra, can send it anywhere but to the buyer or the supplier.
heard: Silence can't freeze the money, and nobody, not even ARA, can send it anywhere but to the buyer or the supplier.

text: The same contract works for any deal with a deposit and a balance: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.
heard: The same contract works for any deal with a deposit and a balance. A house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.

text: Arra is live on Celo mainnet. A friend's real order ran start to finish: locked, accepted with the deposit, balance paid.
heard: ARA is live on Cello Mainnet. A friend's real order ran start to finish. Locked, accepted with the deposit, balance paid.

text: With a verified contract, a registered agent, and naira orders filled through Textile.
